USNS WALLY SCHIRRA (T-AKE 8) VRA KR

The contractor shall provide all labors, material, tools and equipment to accomplish the Voyage Repair Availability for the USNS WALLY SCHIRRA (T-AKE 8) as described in accordance with the Work specification MSCOK 26-008 and the SECTION J, Attachment J-1 of the solicitation.

This solicitation is intended only for sources duly authorized to operate and do business in S. Korea as prescribed by DFARS 252.225-7042.

Amendment 0001 dated 3 Mar 2026 - To provide response to the Request for Clarifications received.
